label: Pay frequency
note: 26 = every two weeks; two or three months carry three paychecks.

label: Giving floor
note: Never below this share of gross.

label: Giving target
note: Work toward this share of gross.

label: Savings target
note: Share of gross planned into the Savings group.

label: Housing cap
note: Housing and utilities over net paychecks.

label: Debt-to-income cap
note: Debt payments over gross; the household's own line, not a lender's.

label: Housing debt-to-income cap
note: Rent, utilities and any mortgage over gross.

label: Emergency fund target
note: Months of outgo the emergency savings should cover.

label: Investing per paycheck
note: Deposited outside the budget app; not in the exports.
